question: After repairing the missing inbound account propagation, should Microsoft Teams adopt `channels.msteams.accounts` plus `defaultAccount`, retain root-level configuration as the implicit default account, and require a separate webhook port for each named bot account?
rationale: The implementation follows established channel-account seams and has strong live proof, but this choice creates a durable public configuration and operator topology that code review alone cannot authorize.

options.title: Adopt the proposed contract
options.body: Approve the cross-channel account shape and separate-port listener model after the narrow blocker is repaired and refreshed validation passes.

options.title: Require shared-listener multiplexing
options.body: Pause merge and redesign named accounts around one listener with account-specific webhook paths before publishing the contract.

recommendation.title: Adopt the proposed contract
recommendation.body: Approve the cross-channel account shape and separate-port listener model after the narrow blocker is repaired and refreshed validation passes.
